notes: [rk-399 finding 2] A run bundle DIRECTORY that exists but is empty. git cannot store an empty directory, so the fixture convention places a `.gitkeep` inside it; load.ts records the directory in the `dirs` fact but EXCLUDES `.gitkeep` from bundle content (corpus/README.md 'empty-directory fixtures'). The old file-prefix-only model could not see the empty dir and reported 0/0 clean (false PASS, gate-contracts.md:862); the gate now enumerates the bundle from `dirs` and ERRORs on the missing README, counting it 1/1.
